label: Underpass
observer_note: A low continuous rush; occasional footsteps interrupt it and vanish before the next one.

label: Potting shed
observer_note: The vessel fills in quick uneven taps, then one louder spill; long silence at the end.

label: Back stair
observer_note: Two loose pipes seem to answer each other, sometimes at once; a distant door closes midway.

label: Window ledge
observer_note: Fine ticks cover almost the whole recording; near the center several merge into a short scrape.

label: Empty basin
observer_note: One heavy impact, a softer return, then smaller returns that become difficult to separate.

label: Service yard
observer_note: A steady high hiss sits behind irregular bursts; the bursts drift farther apart as the room empties.
